children: BLACKBERRY Ltd reported second-quarter results for the period ended Aug 31, 2026, with revenue of $163.3M and diluted EPS of $0.05, driven by stronger licensing and QNX royalties and resulting in higher net income versus the prior-year quarter.
Revenue: $163.3M for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, compared with $129.6M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 26.0%.
Net income: $33.9M for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, compared with $13.3M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 154.9%.
Diluted EPS: $0.05 for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, compared with $0.02 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue growth was driven by strong QNX royalties and licensing, lifting first-half revenue to $316.2M, up $64.9M year over year.
Channel and mix shifted toward higher-margin Licensing and QNX (royalties, developer licenses); SecuSUITE hardware reduced COMM margins.
Product momentum included an Alloy Kore design win with Coretura (the company cites this as its largest QNX win, with backlog exceeding $100M) and continued QNX wins plus SDP 8.0 ecosystem expansion.
Operational scaling: R&D investment increased by roughly 30% to support vehicle, Physical AI and safety-certified solutions; professional services also grew.
Recurring revenue: Secure Communications ARR edged up to $221M, while DBNRR eased to 91%, prompting a cautious outlook for government opportunities.
